recommendations.proposal: Show current-to-next values, missing prerequisite and next revealed benefit; do not hide essential systems behind unrelated convenience nodes
Use separated functional hub points with one primary interaction, explicit unavailable reason and optional reduced flash/short repeated dance
Use abstract six-direction visual order for our small graph; fill only meaningful functional branches, not fake locked nodes
Add a material only after naming its unique use and regional supply; measure gathering/travel/sale bottlenecks before copying queues or automation
